description: This repository's own updates, on top of the shared preset KevinDeBenedetti/renovate-config (Monday-morning schedule, best practices, SHA-pinned actions, prek hook revs, labels, data-owning image majors held for approval).

customManagers.description: The hadolint image the prek hook runs (`entry = "ghcr.io/hadolint/hadolint:<tag>@<digest> hadolint"`): the hook's own entry would run `latest`, whatever its `rev` says.

packageRules.description: A week, not the preset's 3 days: uv (`exclude-newer = "7 days"` in pyproject.toml) and bun (`minimumReleaseAge` in apps/next/bunfig.toml) refuse a younger release, so an earlier bump would fail its lock file update. Security updates do not wait.
The preset's exemptions again, since the rule above comes after them: these update types carry no release timestamp of their own.
Renovate gets a release date from Docker Hub only: the ghcr.io images (uv, hadolint) would never pass the soak.
The hadolint hook's rev and the image its entry runs move together.
Capped below 2 in pyproject.toml until the Hub code (services/hub.py, huggingface.py) is checked against 2.x: drop this together with the cap.
Python and Node runtime upgrades are deliberate (CI, the lockfiles and the images move together), not part of the weekly batch. Patches and digests still flow.
